title: upfly undo --json: the result
description: The line upfly undo --json prints when it finishes: what it put back, or null when nothing was undone. With --file, and --line, it undoes part of the last run and part says which; with --list it undoes nothing and run lists what the last run changed. A run that refuses, because a file changed since the run or another run is going, prints an error line instead (events.json) and changes nothing.

undone.description: The run undone, or the part of it, or null when nothing was undone: no run was left to undo, the part asked for was undone already, or --list was given.

restored.description: Originals the run had removed, back in place.

reverted.description: Files whose references are as they were again: every one of them, or for part of a run, the one file whose lines were put back.

removed.description: Files the run had created, gone again. Always empty for part of a run: what the run created stays until the whole run is undone, since other lines may still name it.

moved.description: Images the run had moved, back where they were: from is where each is again, to where the run had put it. For part of a run the image is copied back, and stays at to as well.

part.description: With --file, the part of the run asked for: the file, as a path inside the project, and with --line the line, counted from 1, else null for all of the file's changes. null for the whole run, and with --list.

commit.description: The commit --commit made for that run, or null. It stays in the history, so the files undo put back show as uncommitted changes.

notes.description: Each a sentence: why there was nothing to undo, or what to do about the commit.

run.description: With --list only: what the last run changed, as it stands now, or null when no run has written to the project. With --file, files holds that file alone.

state.description: applied while the run stands, even when parts of it were undone on their own; undone once the whole run was; interrupted when it stopped part way, which only the whole run's undo puts back.

files.description: Each file the run rewrote, in path order, with its changes line by line.

originals.description: Each image the run removed, or moved away, in path order, and whether it is back.

path.description: Where it was before the run.

movedTo.description: Where the run moved it, or null for an original it removed.

back.description: Whether it is at path again, as it was.

changedSince.description: Something other than the run put a different file at path, or changed the moved file, so it cannot be brought back.

created.description: The files the run created, in path order: converted images, and moved images at their new place. Only the whole run's undo removes them.

changedSince.description: Something other than the run, or an undo of it, changed the file since, so none of its changes can be undone on its own until it holds a text the run's record knows again.

changes.description: The lines the run changed, in order.

line.description: The line, counted from 1, in the file as the run left it, which upfly undo --line takes. null only for a run an older Upfly recorded, whose file changed since.

undone.description: Whether the line is undone; null when the file changed since, so its state cannot be told.

text.description: The whole line as it was before the run and as the run left it, without its line break, so a reader can show the change without rebuilding it. null when the file changed since, or for a run an older Upfly recorded whose line is undone.

paths.description: Each path the run rewrote on the line.

before.description: The path as it was written before the run.

after.description: The path the run wrote, or null for a run an older Upfly recorded when the file no longer holds it.

image.description: The image before names, as a path inside the project, or null for a run an older Upfly recorded. Undoing the line brings it back when the run removed or moved it.

inComment.description: The path is inside a comment, which no page loads.
